## Release Candidate Checklist

Target branch must be `release/*`.

- [ ] `qc` check is green
- [ ] `e2e` check is green
- [ ] `build` check is green
- [ ] `doc/RELEASE_READINESS.md` updated with current evidence
- [ ] No open `P0` blockers remain
- [ ] `npm run qc:full` executed on this branch

## Evidence

- CI run URL:
- `qc:full` log/snippet:
- Release notes link:
